policy: Every secret must be activated through normal controller input and verified by game-owned RAM, rendered frames, and deterministic repeated results. Community claims are not accepted until reproduced on the exact ROM.

secrets.claim: Password EECJJ unlocks regular level selection; pressing A/B on Continue changes the starting round.
secrets.result: exact ROM reached level value 112 in the compatibility probe

secrets.claim: Password EECFG unlocks Super level selection.
secrets.result: exact ROM reached level value 112 in the compatibility probe
acceptance: Super-mode state still needs a dedicated anchor
enemy or mode state differs from regular route

secrets.claim: Password HCICD enables Super Bubble Bobble graphics.

acceptance: false claim retained as compatibility evidence if rejected

secrets.claim: Collect the crystal on Round 99 to open the secret road.
Bring the second player into the final battle with Start, Select, Start before defeating the final enemy to obtain the best ending and sound test.
Gameplay counters determine candy, shoes, elemental items, umbrellas, books and other special items.
acceptance: counter threshold reached without RAM patch
Player 1 and Player 2 ownership routes recorded separately

secrets.claim: Some community cheat lists give DDFFI as a level-select password.
acceptance: retain exact-ROM result even if rejected

secrets.claim: A dead player can take one remaining life from the other player; sources disagree whether Start alone or Start then Select is required.
acceptance: test Start alone and Start/Select separately

secrets.claim: The NES port has no ordinary no-death secret rooms; the Round 99 crystal gate is the exceptional hidden route.
acceptance: do not import arcade secret-room assumptions into NES tests
